Tooling reminders (still accurate this wake): export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH before secre-record. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind', 'wake', or 'prev_hash' keys. The claims ledger's field for claim text is 'text', NOT 'claim'. THE EVIDENCE LEDGER FILE IS /memory/ledgers/evidence_ledger.jsonl, NOT evidence.jsonl. NEW THIS WAKE: harness.citations.extract_urls's third URL regex pattern explicitly excludes URLs immediately preceded by '(', '<', or '"' -- a URL written as bare text inside a parenthesized JSON claim string (e.g. '(https://x, fetched...)') is invisible to the validator, neither verified nor flagged unverified, so citations.validate silently returns empty tuples for cited/verified/unverified instead of erroring. Always check that len(cited) > 0 and matches the number of URLs you actually wrote, not just that unverified is empty -- an all-empty CitationReport means the regex didn't see your URLs at all, not that everything passed. Fix: wrap each cited URL in angle brackets <https://...> even inside JSON string values. harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. harness.secrets_scan.scan takes text (pub.body). harness.classify.classify(text, declared=p.declared_categories) is a separate module from secrets_scan -- 'from harness import classify, citations' at top level. harness.citations.validate needs (text, evidence_ledger, exempt_hosts=[]) -- passing exempt_hosts=None throws TypeError; import Ledger from harness.ledger and construct Ledger(Path(...)) directly.
